The '''Jungle Island''' is a sub-location of [[The Park]].

{{ZoneText|Chop down Jungle logs.}}

== Features ==
The '''Jungle Island''' features a few attractions.

=== Juliette ===
{{Main|Juliette}}
{{NPCSprite|Juliette}} is an [[NPC]] located on the floating island. She is part of the [[Romero and Juliette]] Quest, and asks the player to get her back with {{NPCSprite|Romero}} by giving him certain items. [[Romero]] will give the player an item back, which must be given to [[Juliette]] to progress in the quest.

=== Molbert ===
{{Main|Molbert}}
{{NPCSprite|Molbert}} will task you with collecting {{Item|Jungle Wood}}, {{Item|Carrot}}s, and {{Item|String}} to build traps to capture moles that are ruining the beauty of the park. However, he ends up getting trapped in his own traps and reveals that he is indeed a mole, and gives you the {{Item|Mole Hat}} as compensation for your troubles.

=== Spirit Cave ===
{{Main|Spirit Cave}}
Near the middle of the '''Jungle Island''' lies a breakable wall that can be blown up with an {{Item|Explosive Bow}} or {{Item|Superboom TNT}}. Here, you will find the {{Zone|Spirit Cave}}, where {{Item|Pack Spirit}}s, {{Item|Howling Spirit}}s, and {{Item|Soul of the Alpha}}s will spawn. This is one of three caves designed for [[Wolf Slayer]].
